defects.title: Unpublished verified stranded-input stage can be deleted after its matching global source is lost
defects.defect_class: stage cleanup / known-good-copy preservation / batch transaction rollback complexity
defects.preconditions: An existing multi-Hub registry has at least two stranded identity-bound Hub inputs. A later entry has already been copied to and hash-verified in its destination-local stage, then its matching global source changes or disappears before that entry is published, causing fresh commit-boundary source revalidation to fail.
defects.bad_behavior: The reconciliation finally block removes every remaining stage unconditionally. If the global source no longer contains the verified bytes and the stage has not yet been published, cleanup can delete the only surviving verified copy while the operation fails.
defects.root_cause: Whole-batch staging and rollback make temporary stages part of the data-safety transaction, but final cleanup treats them as disposable scratch files without first proving that another exact verified copy still exists. This is a product transaction-semantics defect, not an Entry Reachability coverage-count defect.

evidence.id: finally removes every remaining plan.Stage without proving matching source or durable destination still holds the expected SHA-256

defects.title: Token-bound UpdateAll cannot execute its Manager-global phase when the captured active Hub is missing or corrupt
defects.defect_class: pre-dispatch reachability / mixed Manager-global and Hub-bound update phase ordering
defects.preconditions: A valid multi-Hub registry and active metadata identify the same instance_id captured by an explicit ExpectedInstanceId token, the active Hub path is missing or the Hub is structurally invalid, and UpdateAll has a valid newer Manager package available in the Manager-global inbox.
defects.bad_behavior: Resolve-RegisteredInstanceContextEarly validates active Hub health before Invoke-Update. The top-level unresolved-registry catch does not allow UpdateAll to dispatch, so the process aborts before the Manager-global update phase. The valid Manager package remains unconsumed even though canonical rules require the Manager phase to remain independent while the captured Hub phase later fails closed without retargeting.
defects.root_cause: Pre-dispatch policy represented UpdateAll only as a Hub-context-dependent action. It did not distinguish a fully captured registry target identity from successful active-Hub health resolution, so a failure in the Hub half of the mixed operation incorrectly suppresses the independent Manager-global half.

evidence.id: 55 derived edges executed; 53 PASS; only EDGE-033 REGISTRY_ACTIVE_HUB_CORRUPT x UpdateAll and EDGE-034 REGISTRY_ACTIVE_HUB_MISSING x UpdateAll failed; harness_error=false
